metadata.Name: X-stance
metadata.Description: A multilingual stance detection dataset containing 67,000 comments on political issues in German, French and Italian. The data comes from Swiss election candidates answering questions about their political positions.
metadata.Paper Title: X-stance: A Multilingual Multi-Target Dataset for Stance Detection
Affiliations: Department of Computational Linguistics, University of Zurich
School of Informatics, University of Edinburgh
metadata.Abstract: We extract a large-scale stance detection dataset from comments written by candidates of elections in Switzerland. The dataset consists of German, French and Italian text, allowing for a cross-lingual evaluation of stance detection. It contains 67 000 comments on more than 150 political issues ( targets ). Unlike stance detection models that have specific target issues, we use the dataset to train a single model on all the issues. To make learning across targets possible, we prepend to each instance a natural question that represents the target (e.g. 'Do you support X?'). Baseline results from multilingual BERT show that zero-shot crosslingual and cross-target transfer of stance detection is moderately successful with this approach.
